task.title: Verify your email information
task.shortdesc: You may receive an email verification request while logging in to a Red Hat portal. Follow the steps to verify your email address when this request appears:

ul.li: Ensure you have a registered Red Hat user account.
Ensure you have an email address where you can receive a verification notice.
Confirm that you receive an email verification request notice when you log in to a Red Hat platform.

step.cmd: Log in to your Red Hat user account.
When a verification alert message appears, click Resend verification email if you have not yet received a verification email.
Check your email for an email verification message from no-reply@redhat.com.
Follow the instructions in the email for verifying your email address.
When you complete the instructions, a verification window appears.
